purpose: Hold failures discovered outside the active roadmap slice so they remain visible without silently expanding that slice, changing its dependency graph or starting an unbounded probe-and-fix loop.

ownership_boundary.current_roadmap_exclusion: A queued item is not part of SAR, TLR, Planning Definition Editor or Planning MCP unless the user explicitly promotes it through a separate roadmap change.
ownership_boundary.mutation_rule: Discovery records evidence only. Diagnosis, source edits and tests require a new serialized claim whose slice_id names the regression item.
ownership_boundary.priority_rule: Queue order never preempts the explicit user-directed roadmap sequence. Severity may trigger a user notification but does not grant mutation authority.
ownership_boundary.completion_rule: An item closes only with a dedicated claim, root-cause evidence, focused regression coverage and an explicit disposition of fixed, duplicate, invalid or accepted_risk.

suite_policy.full_suite_rule: Run the repository-wide suite only at the declared integration points. Do not rerun it after each slice and do not start another probe solely to reveal the next unrelated failure.

failure_routing.related_to_active_slice: Keep the integration point red and return the owning slice to running or blocked with exact evidence.
failure_routing.independent_or_relationship_unproven: Append one deduplicated regression item, leave the current roadmap membership unchanged and continue only when the integration point's declared gate permits it.
failure_routing.environment_only: Record blocked_environment evidence without modifying tests, quarantines or product code.

integration_points.run_once: unchanged repository-wide suite in the best available local environment
integration_points.acceptance_boundary: Focused slice evidence remains authoritative for slice completion; independent failures are queued and do not become SAR work automatically. SAR-01 remains blocked_environment unless the run is symlink-capable and uses no diagnostic deselections.

integration_points.run_once: unchanged repository-wide suite after the TLR-01 through TLR-06 focused and integration tests are green
integration_points.acceptance_boundary: A TLR-related failure blocks the responsible TLR slice; every unrelated failure is routed here without expanding TLR.

integration_points.run_once: unchanged repository-wide suite after both Planning integrations pass their focused contracts
integration_points.acceptance_boundary: Planning-related failures block the integration handoff; unrelated failures are routed here without expanding either Planning roadmap.
